scene: Steam hisses as the automaton raises three glowing transit platform gates.
picture: A flat side view along the wooden harbour pier. The Pacific Islander man with top knot and ukulele stands centre beside the automaton. On the left waits a green maglev dragon train. Up high hangs a round cable pod over a ladder. On the right, a neon-pink bullet train sits on elevated tracks.
shown: a sleek dragon-headed maglev train with open passenger doors on the left
a round glass cloud cable pod swaying gently on its cable up high
a neon-pink high-speed bullet train waiting at the station on the right
